units.source_text: 我心头一阵郁闷，胃部沉甸甸的。

en.t: A wave of gloom came over my heart, and my stomach felt heavy.

units.source_text: 这不是由于喝酒的关系，而是因为一到紧急关头，我的欲望就增加了重量，

en.t: This was not because I had been drinking, but because whenever a crisis came, my desire grew heavier,

units.source_text: 一种从我的肉体分离出来的抽象的结构就压在我的肩上。

en.t: and an abstract structure, separated from my flesh, pressed down upon my shoulders.

units.source_text: 我感到它简直是一具漆黑的、沉重的、铁制的机床。

en.t: I felt it was nothing less than a pitch-black, heavy, iron machine tool.
